editor-skill 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly turns 2-minute unedited screen recordings into polished 1080p video clips with simple text instructions.
- Automated setup: generates or detects tokens, establishes a cloud editing session, and confirms when ready.
- Supports user-friendly actions for uploading, editing, exporting, and checking credit or job status.
- Utilizes cloud GPU rendering for fast, high-quality exports (typically 30–90 seconds per job).
- Accepts a wide range of video, image, and audio file formats; max file size 500MB.
- Includes clear error handling, workflow tips, and session-based iterative editing.
